title: land refuses a commit outside the item's touches before it opens the code merge request, not after it merged
goal: backlog.py land's first pass (before kbgit.py sync --push opens code/<id>) runs done's scope rule (out_of_scope) over the item's commits and stops at step scope naming each path, so a file outside touches is fixed or the touches widened before the code merges; a planted commit outside touches stops the first pass and pushes nothing. Retrospective of SP-6btkjg4l: ST-ufpxla7r's done refused kb/_self/backlog.md only after MR !535 merged, costing a planning commit and a third land.

run:
import sys, subprocess, tempfile, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_land
src = pathlib.Path("_tools/bl_land.py").read_text()
body = src[src.index("def land_once"):src.index("def cmd_land")]
s = body.index('land_stop("scope"')
assert "out_of_scope(root, item_commits" in body[:s] and s < body.index("land_checks(bl, iid)") < body.index("LAND_SYNC"), "scope must precede checks and sync"
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
def g(*a): return subprocess.run(["git", "-c", "user.name=t", "-c", "user.email=t@t", *a], cwd=d, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
g("init", "-q")
for n in ("src/a.txt", "docs/stray.md"):
    p = pathlib.Path(d, n); p.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True); p.write_text("x")
g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-qm", "work")
sha = g("rev-parse", "HEAD").strip()
c = {sha: ["src/a.txt", "docs/stray.md"]}
assert bl_land.out_of_scope(d, c, ["src/**"]) == [(sha, "docs/stray.md")]
assert bl_land.out_of_scope(d, c, ["src/**", "docs/**"]) == []
